name: GD AI Autopilot
description: Autonomous Geometry Dash bot: a Geode C++ bridge streams level state over UDP to a Python physics simulator / beam-search brain and draws a configurable trajectory overlay.

bot-enabled.name: Bot enabled
bot-enabled.description: Master switch for the AI autopilot. Can also be toggled in-game with F6.

visual-preset.name: Visual preset
visual-preset.description: Overlay style. off = completely invisible (vanilla gameplay, minimal network usage), minimal = trajectory line only, showcase = neon paths + corridor + mini HUD, debug = full X-ray with hitboxes and extended telemetry. Cycle in-game with F7.

udp-port.name: UDP port
udp-port.description: Local port used to talk to ai-brain/bot.py. Must match the 'port' value in ai-brain/config.json.
